title: micromeria eugenioides
intro: Micromeria eugenioides, commonly known as the Turkish mountain tea or mountain tea, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce oxidative stress, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Micromeria eugenioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
